'''Canteens''' were objects used to hold [[Water/Legends|water]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]], players may bring a canteen to a [[Unidentified wounded Naboo guard 2|wounded guard]] for help in a mission.
